palette.contrast: legible warm light against cool night and earth tones

texture: subtle weathered stone, woven cloth and fine-grained parchment; natural, tactile and restrained
light: journeying from deep night toward guarded dawn; localized amber illumination without fantasy glow
atmosphere: pilgrimage, displacement, divine accompaniment, patient formation and eventual return
ancient_world_principles: Use plausible ancient Near Eastern travel landscapes, tents, wells, flocks and household materials only when the current aliyah supports them.
Keep clothing and objects simple, functional and regionally plausible without claiming archaeological precision.
Let terrain, distance, night and dawn carry emotional continuity more than decorative symbols.
Represent divine action indirectly through light, space, weather or the current text's explicit imagery; never invent unrelated sacred symbols.
composition_continuity: calm cinematic depth, modest human scale, generous negative space, restrained drama
